title: Flipbook Proof
user: Illustrators and teachers turning a short video into a physical flipbook who need a printable, traceable frame plan before spending days drawing pages.
smallest_useful_product: Client-side web app that ingests a local short clip, lets the user choose frame count and crop, shows adjacent-frame onion skin, and prints numbered trace sheets with a thumbnail contact sheet.
constraints: Local in-browser processing, safe duration caps, no copyrighted examples or automated-art claims.
